title: Everywhere and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：everywhere　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 everywhere 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Everywhere, in 1950 the shopkeeper carried the scale at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the shopkeeper had carried the scale ② everywhere in silence, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier, and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1944 puts it plainer. The scale was ③ everywhere, and the buyer who kept it wrote of the scale ④ everywhere in the same line; nothing in the shop was ever left everywhere for long in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ everywhere, and ⑥ Everywhere came the buyer who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ everywhere at the counter, and that everybody be ⑧ everywhere before the July rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried everywhere.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she carried the scale ⑨ everywhere twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Everywhere, she said in 1962, that was the part the shop never forgot; the account still speaks of it everywhere. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot how everywhere it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 到处（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the scale everywhere，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 到处（作表语，说明处所或去向：the scale was everywhere）
C. adv. 处处（置于句首：Everywhere, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 处处（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the scale everywhere）
E. adv. 处处（作介词宾语：from everywhere）
F. adv. 处处（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Everywhere came the buyer）
G. adv. 到处（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be counted everywhere at the counter）
H. adv. 到处（be everywhere 说明所在或去向：everybody be everywhere before the rains）

answers.why: everywhere 意为“处处”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Everywhere, in 1950 …。
everywhere 意为“到处”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the scale everywhere。
everywhere 意为“到处”，此处作表语说明那件小小的秤的去向或所在：was everywhere。
everywhere 意为“处处”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the scale everywhere。
everywhere 意为“处处”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from everywhere。
everywhere 意为“处处”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Everywhere came the buyer。
everywhere 意为“到处”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be counted everywhere at the counter。
everywhere 意为“到处”，be everywhere 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
everywhere 意为“到处”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬运那件小小的秤，副词置于句末。
everywhere 意为“处处”，母亲 1962 年那句话以地点状语开头：Everywhere, …。
